note: Adversarial review. 28 cases pre-registered at 6bc05f1, before this code existed, and not adjusted to what arrived. First run found 2 defects: evidence accepted from the working tree though never committed, and an uppercase-hex filename accepted on a case-insensitive filesystem. Both closed by a0c4dd2; re-run against the pair gives 28/28. Fired rather than read: nine field-corruption cases each block independently; the tree recompute is real, proven by the case where filename and commit field were both updated to the new SHA and only the tree left stale; the evidence-only exemption cannot carry code and is not satisfied by a prefix directory; the gate is not exempt from itself (.githooks/ and its own script both gated); a range push carrying three commits with evidence for one is blocked and names each. Deadlock checked before it was needed: a pure-evidence commit is ungated, so the repo cannot wedge itself.
